story_text:
SecondBrain VoicePad is a five-key AI gadget for your desk.
Hold a key and talk, and clean text lands in any app on your Mac or PC. Double-tap, and your meeting turns into a transcript, a summary and next steps. The other keys do whatever you set them to: open an app, fire a shortcut, or run a whole routine.
Emails, Slack replies, prompts for ChatGPT and Claude, notes to yourself. Most of what you type, you could just say. Hold the wide key, talk, and let go. VoicePad types it wherever your cursor is.
You don't have to talk like you're reading a script. VoicePad drops the ums, the repeats and the false starts, and keeps what you meant. Voice typing is unlimited in your first year, then 4,000 words a week, free.
## KOL&PR
Made for open offices. The two mics sit right at your mouth, not across the desk in your laptop, so a quiet voice still gets every word.
Give any key its own way of speaking. Translate to English takes any of 50+ languages. Professional Rewrite polishes what you said. Terminal Helper turns a request into a command. Screen Dictation reads what's on your screen, so names and terms come out right.
## MEETING NOTES
Double-tap to start. Double-tap to stop.
VoicePad records the meeting in the room or on a call, even without your computer, then hands you the transcript, a summary and the next steps.
## CUSTOM KEYS
Every key does what you tell it. Set them up in the free Genspark Super App for Mac and Windows, and choose whether each one works with a tap, a double-tap or a hold.
A few examples. Hands-free Mode, Live translation and screen recording are among the voice actions. Spotlight, Mission Control and lock screen are among the shortcuts. And on macOS, a key can run a command inside an app, like Raise hand in Teams, a new tab in your browser, or your unread messages in Slack.
Smart Action is a routine on one key. Pick the press, line up the steps, and voice steps can even follow your own custom instructions. Three to start with:
• Ask Claude. Open Claude › wait 0.5 s › dictate › press Return.
• Voice to checklist. Open Notes › dictate › AI prompt: “Turn this into a checklist.”
• Stand-up update. Open Slack › type “Stand-up:” › Professional Rewrite › press Return.
## ANY APP, ANY AI
Push-to-talk stays on the wide key. The other four, by role:
- Founder: Meeting Notes, AI Slides, Ask Claude, AI Workspace
- Sales: Meeting Notes, Gmail, Teams › Mute, Professional Rewrite
- Engineer: Terminal Helper, Region screenshot, VS Code, Ask Claude
- Legal and finance: Meeting Notes, Excel, Scrolling screenshot, Professional Rewrite
- Teacher: Start/stop recording, PowerPoint, Screen recording, Translate to English
- On calls all day: Meeting Notes, Teams › Mute, Teams › Raise hand, Live translation
## HARDWARE
Every key sits on a CHERRY MX Ultra Low Profile Tactile switch, CHERRY's ultra-low-profile mechanical switch, just 3.9 mm tall. The press is short and crisp with a clear tactile point, so you know it registered without looking.
## WITH GENSPARK
VoicePad works on its own. If you also use Genspark, one key can hand a whole task to Genspark's AI agents. Press AI Workspace, say what you need, and Genspark writes the report, builds the slides or fills in the sheet.You never need a Genspark subscription to use VoicePad. The default keys are only a starting point.
Everything you use day to day is included. The 1,000 Super Agent credits that come with VoicePad are yours to use in your first year.
Already a Genspark Plus, Pro or Team member? You get unlimited voice typing with VoicePad, and transcription and translation draw on the 24 free hours a day included with your plan.
- Microphones: 2
- Speaker: built in
- Body: CNC-machined aluminum, 85 g
- Battery: about 20 hours per charge
- Connection: Bluetooth or USB-C cable
- Works with: macOS and Windows, through the free Genspark Super App
- Records without a computer: yes
- In the box: VoicePad, metal plate for the magnetic mount, USB-C to USB-C cable, quick start guide, safety and warranty guideGenspark.ai is a Palo Alto-based AI company founded in 2023, building agentic AI for knowledge workers worldwide. It orchestrates 70+ leading AI models to turn business objectives into finished deliverables, and works across web, desktop, mobile, and hardware.
## Why Kickstarter?
We could have gone straight to stores. We're launching here because Kickstarter backers try new tools first, and we want them shaping VoicePad.
The first run goes to backers. VoicePad's first production run ships to backers before it reaches any store.
Your feedback shapes the software. Keys, actions and Smart Actions update over the air, and backers tell us what to build next.
We build for real demand. Pledges set the size of the first production run, so we make what people actually want.
Plenty of established hardware companies launch this way. Bose, Sony, GE Appliances, Anker and EcoFlow have all launched new products through crowdfunding.
## Timeline
risks: VoicePad is past the prototype stage. Two trial production runs are complete, and the software it works with, Genspark Super App, is already live. Hardware still carries risk, so here is what could go wrong and how we will handle it. Production timing. Component shortages or low yields could delay the first mass-production run, scheduled for November 2026. It uses the same design and process we validated in both trial runs, and it starts before the campaign ends. If anything slips, we will post an update right away with the reason and the new dates. Software. VoicePad's pairing and key-setup screens are still being polished. Everything else already works in Speakly today. The finished screens will arrive as an over-the-air app update before your VoicePad does, so this work won't hold up shipping. Speech and translation accuracy. Like any speech technology, VoicePad can mishear words in a noisy room and get uncommon names and terms wrong. The text lands where you can check it before you send it, you can add your own names and terms to Speakly's Dictionary, and the speech and language models keep improving through regular updates. Online services. Dictation, translation, Ask Genspark and meeting notes rely on Genspark's online services, which already serve Speakly and SecondBrain Note users today. Without a connection, VoicePad can still record audio and play it back on the device. Shipping and import fees. The campaign ends just before the holidays, and Lunar New Year (February 2027) slows factories, freight and customs. Import duties and tariffs have also changed often. We plan to start shipping in January 2027, and the backer survey will explain shipping costs and any import fees for your country before anything ships. We will post tracking information for every shipping wave. Certification and batteries. Electronics need regional certification, and lithium batteries must pass transport testing before they can ship by air. We will report the status of both in our project updates before shipping begins. Demand. If orders exceed the first production run, we will ship in waves in pledge order, VIP backers first, and post the dates for each wave. Updates. From the end of the campaign until every reward has shipped, we will post a project update at least every two weeks.
